entryCoverage: Exactly one entry per inventory id, including unmoved helpers and shared support helpers; no dropped or duplicate original id
rangeConvention: Inclusive one-based line numbers against accepted Git bytes for original and actual delivered bytes for destination
originalSourceAuthority: git show a905653d557f4c5246a1f656042cb8d29e46c052:PATH; baseline files are indexes, not substitutes for immutable originals
tokenAlgorithm: capture.py lex() and token_sha(): preserve literal bytes as whole tokens, discard comments/whitespace, SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON token array with ensure_ascii=False
independentComparison: QA must reread Git and destination bytes, compare actual bodies, assertions, literals, loops, helper calls, attributes and declaration/drop order; stored equal flags alone are not proof
comments: Raw hashes retain comments. Review any raw-byte difference after removing only common leading indentation. Comments are not authorized for deletion or rewriting by the token comparator
attributes: Preserve every test and platform attribute; inherited cfg(test) may move to the explicit module declaration. Preserve derive attributes and the shared support allow(dead_code)

declarations.coverage: Account for nonfunction helper declarations, constants, imports, trait implementations and their attributes, including Fixture/Daemon/EntrySnapshot, timeouts, fixture counter, shared Serial and THREAD
declarations.production: IPC production prefix lines 1-354 stays byte-identical; daemon production, migrations, manifests, lockfile and harness rules stay byte-identical

permittedMechanicalDifferences.scope: Test/helper source locations and resulting qualified test/module names
Leading Rust source indentation needed for ordinary module moves, with literal bytes and comments preserved
Explicit mod/use declarations and private helper reexports/imports; keep one resident integration target
Only private pub(super) or pub(crate) exposure needed between test modules; no production or public IPC visibility changes
Only if probe is moved: replace the --exact fixture_serialization_probe selector with its actual qualified name; map this literal exception and prove ready/acquired handoff plus nonzero discovery

notPermitted: Changed assertions, case arrays, loops, literals or expected outputs
Fixture lock or child drop-order changes
Textual include or numbered size-only chunks

lineLimit.measurement: Count newline bytes as wc -l and also logical lines; enumerate every resulting source/evidence file including untracked modules

discovery: Record original and final cargo -- --list names. The child probe must select one actual test. Final tests must preserve the same platform availability
